artworks.title: L'Enterrement
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with a church and several figures engaged in an activity. The composition shows an open grave in the foreground, bordered by growing weeds and flowers. In the background, the church and its towering architecture dominate, alongside silhouetted trees against a cloudy sky. The focus is on a congregation-like gathering situated around the grave area. The etched texture and fine detailing give depth to the architecture of the church, the expressions of the figures, and the naturalistic environment.

artworks.title: First Vignette
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on imitation vellum paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell

artworks.title: First Vignette
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint with letter press on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a devilish figure overshadowing and interacting with another figure. The artwork is within an ornate border, with a title, "LE DIABLE AMOUREUX," and accompanying passage in French below.

artworks.title: Second Vignette
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint with letter press on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image features swirling lines and organic shapes forming an abstract scene. These shapes converge into a depiction of a castle-like structure and the outline of a person or creature with arms raised. The surrounding patterns evoke waves or clouds, adding an ethereal quality to the scene. The text below the illustration complements the detailed pictorial elements above.

artworks.title: Third Vignette
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint with letter press on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative illustration incorporated into a page of text. The artwork features an ornate, intricate border encircling a scene depicting several figures in the foreground, while architectural elements or monuments appear faintly in the background. The frame comprises scrolling motifs and possibly mythological or symbolic creatures, adding to the opulent and classical aesthetic of the composition. Below the illustration, there is a block of text formatted in an old-style serif typeface typical of printed materials from a historical text or manuscript. The page is presented in a formal layout, with red lines marking margins or guidelines.

artworks.title: Un Thé Douairières
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint on laid paper,  possibly soaked in turpentine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring a central scene within an ornate frame sketch. In the main scene, three figures are depicted. On the left side, a standing woman in profile wears a long dress and a distinctive headpiece. To her right, another woman sits looking towards the third figure, who is seated in a reclined position. The third figure wears a head wrap or turban. Between them is a small table with objects. The background shows a richly furnished interior. The image is surrounded by an intricate border on aged paper.

artworks.title: I Promessi Sposi
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring a gathering of people in a lavish room. The drawing holds a central composition depicting an elaborately decorated interior with numerous figures dressed in elegant attire. Surrounding this central illustration is an ornate border featuring decorative motifs such as cherubs and flourishes, along with intricate details suggesting a sense of opulence and grandeur. The setting conveys a sense of historical European high society.

artworks.title: Les Adieux
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint on laid  paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate framed scene with a central image showing a dramatic interior encounter. The framing features decorative designs surrounding the scene with the figure embracing and deep shadows creating a sense of movement. The shading and contrast add depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Une Variètè dans L'Amour
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and roulette on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene. The main image is framed by an intricate design with whimsical shapes. Inside, there is a room with various figures and decorative elements.

artworks.title: Caramba, Fit-elle!
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows two horseback riders in a wooded path, with a view from slightly above and behind. The horizon is blocked by tall trees. The painting features delicate brushstrokes showing detailed clothing, textures of horses and trees. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and gray tones. Sketches of human figures and a lion surround the central image.

artworks.title: Le Criard
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image is a print with a central rectangular scene bordered by an etched decorative frame. In the central scene, a lone figure wades through tumultuous water, moving toward the left. The horizon line is high, near the top edge of the rectangle, suggesting that the waves dominate the scene, beneath a stormy sky. The artist employs intricate and expressive etching to capture movement and drama through line work and hatchings, giving texture to the waves and clouds. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, gray, and white for contrast. The decorative frame includes lightly sketched figures and scenes, adding an illustrative quality to the piece.

artworks.title: La Blanche Caroline
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a nighttime scene by a riverbank. The central image shows a figure in a flowing white gown descending steps near a body of water. In the background, there are bare trees and an architectural structure illuminated by moonlight. Shadows and light are used effectively to create a mysterious atmosphere. The borders around the main image include sketches of birds, floral motifs, and whimsical figures.

artworks.title: Ryno et Hermangarde
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a horse and abstract elements. The central image shows a dark horse in motion against a backdrop with swirling clouds or waves. The scene conveys drama and tension through contrast and shading techniques. Surrounding the main image are various etchings of abstract forms, and possibly architectural or natural elements like birds, adding depth to the art. Fine lines and careful etching create a textured and detailed composition.

artworks.title: Le Bas-hamet
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on laid  paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with an elevated viewpoint of a village. The horizon is not visible due to rooftops of houses in the distance. An ornate frame surrounds the scene with sketch-like figures and decorations. A person is walking in the snowy street, and the artwork has soft brushstrokes creating a dreamlike ambiance. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting mainly of grey, black, and white, evoking a nighttime winter setting.

artworks.title: Le Tombeau du Diable
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on laid  paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image features a print with a distinct border that frames the central scene. Depicted in the center is a full-body view of a person seated in a cave-like setting. The person is primarily positioned forward with their dress flowing around them. Facial features are not distinctly visible due to the sketchy technique and shadow play, and their hair appears loose and dark, blending with the background. The attire suggests period-style clothing, enhancing the historical or mythical theme of the artwork. Surrounding the central scene are etched, ghostly figures in the border, seemingly engaged in various poses and activities. The background of the image depicts a dark cavern environment adding a mysterious atmosphere to the composition.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image is a print viewed straightforwardly from a slightly elevated perspective. In the foreground, there is a scene with figures around a tree and a sign. In the middle ground, there are mountains with minimal detail and foliage. The etching style features fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of gray and black. The background has faint outlines and sketches around the detailed central image.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The etching depicts a lively and animated landscape with various creatures and figures. At the center is a windmill and a skeletal tree, creating a focal point. The horizon is obscured by the detailed scene. The intricate lines create detailed textures and environmental elements. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of grey, black, and white. Closest to the viewer are rabbits and goats, with smaller figures and structures in the background.

artworks.title: La Diligence de Beaucaire
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring intricate motifs and an ornate border. The central image depicts a detailed composition of figures and architectural elements. Surrounding the focal point are delicate engravings that suggest an active environment. The lower section includes a framed portrait-like motif surrounded by scrollwork patterns.

artworks.title: Le Secret du Maîtres Cornille
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a collage of illustrative scenes. There are different small panels or sections depicting various scenes, predominantly centered around a windmill motif. The upper section shows a distant view of a windmill surrounded by figures. The right section directly captures the windmill blades. Below, a scene includes a person sitting next to a sack while an animal grazes nearby. The drawing suggests a thematic narrative, focusing on rural life or specific stories associated with windmills. The overall execution of the composition creates a narrative through visual storytelling in a monochrome style.

artworks.title: Le Secret du Maîtres Cornille
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene centered around a windmill. The drawing features a person seated next to a small animal on a textured landscape in front of the windmill. The windmill is detailed with its sails and structure depicted on the right side of the composition. Above the primary scene, there is a smaller depiction of people or animals in motion near the windmill. Several sketched outlines of figures, animals, and objects are around the drawing, enhancing the lively setting. The intricate line work captures a moment filled with narrative elements surrounding the central figure and animal.

artworks.title: Le Curé de Cucugnan
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting mythical creatures and figures in a dark, ornate interior setting. The central imagery shows creatures surrounding a dimly lit room with gothic architecture elements. The scene includes angels, demons, and creatures with wings hovering above a gathering at a harpsichord or organ. Intricate lines, shading, and expressive poses give a sense of movement and otherworldly presence. The drawing is small scale, leaving negative space around the central tableau, emphasizing the detailed inner scene.

artworks.title: Les Vieux
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals in a room. Two adults are near a wardrobe, one holding a door open. Two children are on the floor, one interacting with a small dog. The adults have upstyled hair and wear long dresses. The children are dressed in historical fashion. The wardrobe is ornately decorated, and there is a curtain in the background. The room has a checkered floor and exudes elegance.

artworks.title: Les Vieux
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with figures. The central part of the drawing depicts a detailed scene inside a room, with ornate furniture and decorations. There is a cabinet with intricately designed doors, and within the room, there is a sense of domestic activity. The floor is tiled, and a dog is present. Surrounding the main image are various sketches and doodles, including a pastoral scene at the top with a vast landscape and a person walking, while the sides and bottom have images of animals, flowers, and other figures. The style of drawing is highly detailed and reminiscent of a narrative engraving.

artworks.title: Une Vieux Chantier à Rochester
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a riverside industrial area with a possible dockyard in a horizontal layout. The upper third shows the horizon with windmills and building silhouettes in the distance. The intricate linear strokes create various elements, with denser strokes on the right side suggesting more activity. The left side has fewer linear elements with rounded forms possibly representing barrels or containers. The monochromatic color palette consists of sepia tones, giving the piece a rustic and aged appearance. The detailed structures and objects, along with a figure engaged in labor, provide a sense of scale to the setting.
